mesures_apres.requete:
SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(g.cli_id IS NULL OR g.nature_personne IS NULL
       OR g.nature_personne<>'PP' OR g.date_naissance IS NULL OR c.date_debut IS NULL
       OR TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR,g.date_naissance,c.date_debut)<18),0) ko
       FROM gold.contrat_certifie c LEFT JOIN gold.client_unique g
       ON g.cli_id=c.cli_souscripteur AND g._batch_id=c._batch_id
       WHERE c._batch_id=:b AND (g.nature_personne IS NULL OR g.nature_personne<>'PM')

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(t.code_type IS NULL),0) ko FROM gold.contrat_certifie c
       LEFT JOIN bronze.crm_type_contrat t ON t.code_type=c.code_type AND t._batch_id=c._batch_id WHERE c._batch_id=:b

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(g.cli_id IS NULL),0) ko FROM gold.contrat_certifie c
       LEFT JOIN gold.client_unique g ON g.cli_id=c.cli_souscripteur AND g._batch_id=c._batch_id WHERE c._batch_id=:b

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(g.cli_id IS NULL),0) ko FROM gold.contrat_certifie c
       LEFT JOIN gold.client_unique g ON g.cli_id=c.cli_assure AND g._batch_id=c._batch_id WHERE c._batch_id=:b AND c.cli_assure IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(c.contrat_id IS NULL),0) ko FROM gold.sinistre_certifie s
       LEFT JOIN gold.contrat_certifie c ON c.contrat_id=s.contrat_id AND c._batch_id=s._batch_id WHERE s._batch_id=:b

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gold.contrat_certifie d
        WHERE d._batch_id=s._batch_id AND d.cli_souscripteur=c.cli_souscripteur AND d.code_type=c.code_type
        AND s.date_survenance BETWEEN d.date_debut AND d.date_fin)),0) ko FROM gold.sinistre_certifie s
        LEFT JOIN gold.contrat_certifie c ON c.contrat_id=s.contrat_id AND c._batch_id=s._batch_id WHERE s._batch_id=:b

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gold.contrat_certifie c
        WHERE c.cli_souscripteur=g.cli_id AND c._batch_id=g._batch_id)),0) ko FROM gold.client_unique g WHERE g._batch_id=:b AND g.statut_client='PROSPECT'

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gold.contrat_certifie c
        WHERE c.cli_souscripteur=g.cli_id AND c._batch_id=g._batch_id)),0) ko FROM gold.client_unique g WHERE g._batch_id=:b AND g.statut_client IN ('ACTIF','INACTIF','A_REVOIR')

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM((g.statut_client='ACTIF') <> EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM gold.v_client_actif a
        WHERE a.cli_id=g.cli_id AND a._batch_id=g._batch_id)),0) ko FROM gold.client_unique g WHERE g._batch_id=:b
SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(date_fin IS NULL OR date_debut IS NULL OR date_fin<=date_debut),0) ko FROM gold.contrat_certifie WHERE _batch_id=:b
SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(duree_garantie_mois IS NULL OR duree_garantie_mois NOT IN (12,24,36,60)),0) ko FROM gold.contrat_certifie WHERE _batch_id=:b

SELECT COUNT(*) n,
          COALESCE(SUM((x.cli_id IS NULL OR g.cli_id IS NULL) AND q.silver_row_id IS NULL),0) ko,
          COALESCE(SUM(q.silver_row_id IS NOT NULL),0) exclusions_rq019
          FROM `silver`.`client` s
          LEFT JOIN `gold`.`xref_identifiants` x ON x.silver_row_id=s.silver_row_id
            AND x.bronze_row_id=s.bronze_row_id AND x.source_systeme=s.source_systeme AND x.source_id=s.source_id
          LEFT JOIN `gold`.`client_unique` g ON g.cli_id=x.cli_id AND g._batch_id=s._batch_id
          LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT ref.source_systeme,ref.source_id,ref.bronze_row_id,ref.silver_row_id,b._batch_id
            FROM `dq`.`rq019_reference_xref_identifiants` ref
            JOIN `dq`.`rq019_reference_client_unique` b ON b.cli_id=ref.cli_id
            JOIN `dq`.`rq019_etat` e ON e.batch_id=b._batch_id AND e.etat='APPLIQUE'
            JOIN `dq`.`s4_manifeste` m ON m.batch_id=e.batch_id
              AND m.configuration_sha256=e.configuration_sha256
            JOIN `dq`.`rejets` r ON r.batch_id=b._batch_id AND r.entite='client'
              AND r.source_systeme=ref.source_systeme AND r.bronze_row_id=ref.bronze_row_id
              AND r.rule_id='RQ-019' AND r.porte='G' AND r.motif='RQ019_V1_IDENTITE_INCERTAINE'
            WHERE JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(e.plan_json,'$.excluded_cli'),JSON_QUOTE(ref.cli_id))=1
          ) q ON q.silver_row_id=s.silver_row_id AND q.bronze_row_id=s.bronze_row_id
             AND q.source_systeme=s.source_systeme AND q.source_id=s.source_id AND q._batch_id=s._batch_id
          WHERE s._batch_id=:b

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(s.silver_row_id IS NULL OR b.bronze_row_id IS NULL OR g.cli_id IS NULL),0) ko
          FROM `gold`.`xref_identifiants` x
          LEFT JOIN `silver`.`client` s ON s.silver_row_id=x.silver_row_id
            AND s.bronze_row_id=x.bronze_row_id AND s.source_systeme=x.source_systeme
            AND s.source_id=x.source_id AND s._batch_id=:b
          LEFT JOIN `bronze`.`crm_client` b ON b.bronze_row_id=x.bronze_row_id
            AND b.`client_id`=x.source_id AND b._batch_id=:b
          LEFT JOIN `gold`.`client_unique` g ON g.cli_id=x.cli_id AND g._batch_id=:b
          WHERE x.source_systeme='crm'

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(s.silver_row_id IS NULL OR b.bronze_row_id IS NULL OR g.cli_id IS NULL),0) ko
          FROM `gold`.`xref_identifiants` x
          LEFT JOIN `silver`.`client` s ON s.silver_row_id=x.silver_row_id
            AND s.bronze_row_id=x.bronze_row_id AND s.source_systeme=x.source_systeme
            AND s.source_id=x.source_id AND s._batch_id=:b
          LEFT JOIN `bronze`.`cif_clients` b ON b.bronze_row_id=x.bronze_row_id
            AND b.`column0`=x.source_id AND b._batch_id=:b
          LEFT JOIN `gold`.`client_unique` g ON g.cli_id=x.cli_id AND g._batch_id=:b
          WHERE x.source_systeme='cif'

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(s.silver_row_id IS NULL OR b.bronze_row_id IS NULL),0) ko
          FROM `gold`.`contrat_certifie` g LEFT JOIN `silver`.`contrat` s
          ON s.silver_row_id=g.silver_row_id AND s.bronze_row_id=g.bronze_row_id AND s._batch_id=g._batch_id
          LEFT JOIN `bronze`.`crm_contrat` b ON b.bronze_row_id=g.bronze_row_id
          AND b._batch_id=g._batch_id AND b.`contrat_id`=g.`contrat_id` WHERE g._batch_id=:b

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(s.silver_row_id IS NULL OR b.bronze_row_id IS NULL),0) ko
          FROM `gold`.`sinistre_certifie` g LEFT JOIN `silver`.`sinistre` s
          ON s.silver_row_id=g.silver_row_id AND s.bronze_row_id=g.bronze_row_id AND s._batch_id=g._batch_id
          LEFT JOIN `bronze`.`crm_sinistre` b ON b.bronze_row_id=g.bronze_row_id
          AND b._batch_id=g._batch_id AND b.`sinistre_id`=g.`sinistre_id` WHERE g._batch_id=:b

SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(NOT EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM `gold`.`xref_identifiants` x
        LEFT JOIN `silver`.`client` s ON s.silver_row_id=x.silver_row_id
          AND s.bronze_row_id=x.bronze_row_id AND s.source_systeme=x.source_systeme AND s.source_id=x.source_id
        WHERE x.cli_id=g.cli_id AND s._batch_id=g._batch_id)),0) ko
        FROM `gold`.`client_unique` g WHERE g._batch_id=:b
